author: Google
description:
How do you visualize the concept of a world model? Coders Kaloyen Kolev and Arden Schager share how they used Google AI Studio to vibe code custom design tools for Project Genie. They demonstrate how hands-on tools like 3D physics sliders and custom animation timelines enable teams of designers and engineers to work together to explore new ideas together. 

Try vibe coding in Google AI Studio yourself: https://aistudio.google.com/apps
